description: This PHP file defines a database migration class for the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system, specifically for migrating to version 4.1. It contains methods to modify database schema and set configuration values.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Migration class for applying database schema changes and configuration updates for version 4.1 of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the migration tasks such as changing column types in the database and setting configuration values.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version of the migration, which is '4.1'.
